name: reftable-peer-reads
build:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable -b main . &&
printf 'alpha\n' > a.txt && mkdir -p d && printf 'beta\n' > d/b.txt &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m 'initial' &&
printf 'alpha2\n' >> a.txt && git add a.txt &&
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' git commit -q -m 'second' &&
git tag -a v1.0 -m 'release' && git tag light HEAD~1 && git branch topic HEAD~1

name: reftable-peer-clones
build:
git init -q --ref-format=reftable -b main . &&
printf 'x\n' > f && git add f && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m c1 &&
git branch dev && git tag rel
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone && git -C @WORK@/clone show-ref | grep -v refs/remotes
